title: Saba on being single at 50, and if she feels lonely amid her siblings Saif, Soha's marriages

She expressed that finding the right partner has been challenging, though she is open to marriage. Saba emphasized the importance of mutual respect and friendship in a relationship. Despite her single status, she maintains strong bonds with her family and enjoys being involved in their children's lives.

Saba also detailed her responsibilities in managing heritage sites and charitable trusts in Bhopal. Additionally, she mentioned the significance of Rubaths in Makkah and Medina for pilgrims.

title: Nana Patekar’s cause of death revealed: Autopsy report finds blood clot
description: On October 8, Indian cinema lost a true gem, Nana Patekar, who succumbed to a heart attack at his residence. The postmortem indicated that a blood clot in the left main coronary artery was to blame. Despite the valiant efforts of medical responders, he was declared dead at 5:10 am. His funeral, attended by numerous prominent figures, highlighted his profound influence on both Hindi and Marathi film industries.

The movie, directed by Avinash Arun, dives into the prosecution of Ajmal Kasab post the horrific 26/11 Mumbai attacks. title: Tanishaa Mukerji slams 'well-educated elitist Hindus' for ‘blind hate’

As stars from the film industry shared heartfelt birthday wishes, this annual ritual underscored the immense love and admiration his fans have for him, showcasing his continued relevance in cinema.
